hearthandharvest.jei.info.watering_can: Holds %1$s water and %1$s fertilizer. Hold fertilizer in the off hand and use the can to load it, one item per use (one kind at a time). Fill it to full from a water source, from a well (1 bucket) or from a water cauldron (%4$s level(s); a cauldron with fewer levels is emptied for a partial fill). Using it on a crop or other bone-mealable block spends one water and one fertilizer and applies bone meal to the %2$sx%3$s area around it. Using it on a crop or soil also soaks the farmland or Fertile Soil in that area; with no fertilizer, or nothing left to grow, that costs one water. On an even-sized area the extra row is on the side of the block you aim at. It also puts out fire and lit campfires for one water.
